$description: Apollo Legacy override set (ADR-0011: themes = override sets at the semantic tier). Per-mode values Legacy re-binds OVER the Mono base; any path absent here falls back to Mono. Consumed by canon/gen_theme_cascade.py, which generates the [data-apollo-theme="legacy"] cascade into canon.css (AUTO-THEMES block) — root-level canonical vars + per-component vars via each snippet's #token-manifest. Never hand-edit canon.css; edit THIS file and re-run the generator. Every override carries $note provenance: these values are reconstructed from the R-D16/R-D18/R-D20 eviction records and the Legacy-era roles still in the store, NOT invented. Authored 2026-07-21 (build-out Phase 0); extended as Phase-1 per-component finalisation surfaces more Legacy-owned roles.

button/primary/background/default.$note: Legacy brand-red CTA (R-D19: #DB0011 is Legacy's alone). Source: the Legacy-era primary/background/default role still in the store. Mono base is the monochrome ink ladder (B-D1: no red).

button/primary/background/pressed.$note: Source: primary/background/pressed (Legacy pressed flips to black/white — same as Mono).

button/primary/background/disabled.$note: Source: primary/background/disabled. Same values as Mono today; declared so Legacy's disabled state is pinned independently of future Mono edits.

button/primary/label/default.$note: White label on the red CTA, both modes (Legacy convention; cf. text/reverse). Mono's label flips by mode (text/on-inverse).

rag/success.$note: Legacy status teal, mode-stable (registry ownsHexes; R-D15/R-D18 eviction record: bare success was rebased OFF this teal for Mono).

rag/success-glyph.$note: Legacy predates the R-D18 bare/glyph split; both carry the teal.

rag/success-tint.$note: The pre-R-D18 teal tint pair, named in rag/success-tint's own eviction note ('was #E5F2F2 / #001615').

rag/success-background.$note: Legacy success SURFACE = the teal (the R-D14 per-mode green fills are a Mono invention; Legacy's success fill was #00847F). Caught at the Phase-0 exit gate: Button's success state binds rag/success-background, which stayed green until this override. NOTE for Dave: text/on-success is NOT overridden — the black label stays (black-on-teal 6.06:1 AA-pass). Historical Legacy was white-on-teal (3.47:1, AA-fail) — flip only if ruled; it would inscribe a recorded a11y regression into the Legacy set.

rag/error.$note: Legacy error reds (registry ownsHexes: #A8000B light, #DB0011 dark). R-D19: both are Legacy's alone; Mono's only red is #B92F1E.

rag/error-glyph.$note: Legacy predates the glyph split; tracks the bare role.

rag/warning.$note: Legacy amber (color/amber/600), named in rag/warning's R-D20 eviction note. R-D19: Legacy's alone.

rag/warning-glyph.$note: Tracks the bare role (predates the split).

rag/warning-tint.$note: Pre-R-D20 amber tint pair, named in rag/warning-tint's eviction note ('was #FFF8EA / #221701').

rag/information.$note: Legacy navy (color/blue/600 light, color/blue/400 dark), named in rag/information's R-D20 eviction note.

rag/information-glyph.$note: Tracks the bare role (predates the split).

rag/information-tint.$note: Pre-R-D20 blue tint pair, named in rag/information-tint's eviction note ('was #EBEFF4 / #000D1B').

rag/error-background.$note: Legacy predates the R-D14 fill split; tracks the bare role (registry ownsHexes: #A8000B light, #DB0011 dark). Added Phase-1 2026-07-21: required so Legacy FILLS — Badge's rebound surface first — stay Legacy red instead of falling back to the Mono breach fill #B92F1E.

progress/complete.$note: Evicted from the Mono base 2026-07-21 (Dave, Phase-1: 'resolve this to the newer red status color' — worker-A receipt F3; reconfirmed same evening on the harness: 'the colours in legacy … are fine'). Pre-eviction base values (were $alias color/primary, flat #DB0011 both modes). R-D19: #DB0011 is Legacy's alone.

badge/background.$note: Dave 2026-07-21, badge ruling on the harness (verbatim): 'the colours are fine apart from Legacy, it should be the legacy primary red on both light and dark.' Brand-PRIMARY red flat, deliberately NOT the Legacy error pair — that is why the badge/background component slot exists. Known fidelity condition: white numeral on #DB0011 ≈ 4.02:1 (< 4.5 text) — same Legacy-fidelity-vs-AA family as text/on-success white-on-teal, queued for Dave with that item.

text/default.$note: Legacy body ink = Grey 8 #333333 (col25-011: 'white or Grey 8 ONLY'). R-D16 superseded this FOR MONO (mono/4 #1A1A1A) and records 'Grey-8 = Legacy'.

text/secondary.$note: Directly instructed by text/secondary's R-D16 note: 'Legacy retains the dimmer #545454/#9B9B9B as its own theme override.' Mono collapses secondary to the single ink.

border/subtle.$note: Legacy hairline pair (color/grey/300 light) — the pre-R-D16 store values, still documented in the canon.css alias comments. Mono seats borders on the mono ramp (#E1E1E1/#808080).

border-radius/default.$note: Dave 2026-07-21: Legacy = square, same as Mono.
